description: This file defines API route handlers for event-related operations in a FastAPI web application. It includes endpoints to list, retrieve, create, update, and delete events, utilizing SQLAlchemy session dependencies and calling corresponding CRUD functions. The routes are part of an 'Events' API extension with detailed documentation and filtering options.
